title: Wall-Mounted Power Tool Rack – Room for 4 Power Tools
seo_title: Wall-Mounted Power Tool Rack – Room for 4 Power Tools
seo_description: Wall-mounted power tool rack in black metal, 42 × 20 × 35 cm, with room for 4 power tools. A shelf for batteries and hooks for hand tools are included.
descriptionHtml:
The tools are on the bench, the batteries somewhere else

The drills end up in a pile on the workbench in the garage, the batteries charge in a completely different spot, and the bits disappear into a drawer of their own. The next job starts with hunting everything down again before you've even driven a single screw.

One rack, 42 × 20 × 35 cm, with room for 4 tools

The rack in black metal is screwed to the wall and has room for 4 tools that hang by their own handles through openings in the plate. On top there is a shelf for batteries and boxes, and hooks are mounted for hand tools.

Features

  • 4 tools each get their own spot on the wall – the drills hang by their handles through openings in the plate.
  • Takes up limited wall space – the rack measures 42 × 20 × 35 cm.
  • The batteries end up in the same place as the tools – the shelf on top of the plate holds batteries and boxes.
  • Hand tools hang in view instead of disappearing into a drawer – hooks are mounted for hammers, pliers and the like.
